collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: The harvest is in: dance in thanks, or give a quiet thanks.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The harvest is in, the stores are full, and (name1) says it would be wrong not to thank the island for it.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village dances until the moon is high, in a great circle around the fire, the children weaving in and out between the grown-ups' legs.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village gathers for a moment of quiet thanks instead. Nobody speaks. Then, one by one, they go back to their huts, grateful.
